title: list builder
name: List builder — Tidwell
rule: When the user must assemble a list of items, provide a list builder (available vs selected), not a single free-text dump.

citation.source: Designing Interfaces 3e ch. Getting Input — List Builder (Tidwell, Brewer, Valencia)

pass_when: Assembling a list uses available-vs-selected (add/remove) UI.
fail_when: Multi-item list is one free-text dump.
overview: Assemble multi-item lists with available-versus-selected add/remove UI.
apply_when: Users must build a list of items from candidates.
not_when: Single-value fields that are not multi-item lists.
agent_hint: Provide available-vs-selected add/remove; ban one free-text dump for lists.
description: When the user must assemble a list of items, provide a list builder with available versus selected (add/remove), not a single free-text dump. Pass when assembling a list uses that UI; fail when a multi-item list is one free-text dump. The builder makes membership visible and editable without inventing list semantics beyond the cited pattern.
